messages:
marcus: Quick sync for ZephyrCompute joint bench on the Z2000 boards. Aim: map perf/W curve across volt/freq points, validate our quantized 4-bit pipeline, and produce a short ops playbook for marketplace listing.

tess: Love it. Proposed plan: three sweep stages — (1) calibration (single-board), (2) cluster sweep (4 boards), (3) regression (long-run). Dry-run Thurs AM.

ivan: FYI we saw variance on thermal throttling at high seq lengths in earlier runs. Recommend we capture die temps and set conservative fan profiles for stage 2.

zephyr-eng: Noted. We'll bring two instrumented boards with telemetry headers. We'll also ship a FW candidate that reduces VRM hysteresis. Uploading firmware + checksums to s3://zephyr-grid/firmwares/v2026-07-01/sha256=ef12...

bench-bot: automated: tag artifacts with run_id and bench_tag. Use bench_tag=zephyr-z2000-v2026-07 and run_id=20260701-z2000-<board>.

marcus: For metrics, capture: power (sampling=0.5s), GPU utilization, encoder stalls, memory bw, and wall-clock latency. We also need P99 and throughput at batch=1 and batch=16.

ivan: Add pmu counters: L1D_PREFETCH, BUS_TRANSACTIONS, and DRAM_ACT. I'll post perf counter script.

zephyr-eng: We're good on counters. Also request Redwood use the "marketplace-compat" kernel patch set so we can later demo marketplace images without rework.

tess: Agree — include kernel tags in manifest. We'll run both stock kernel and marketplace-compat as A/B. Keep model weights pinned to redwood/llama-13b@v1.5 for parity.

ops-bot: FYI capacity reservation created: reserve-2026-07-01-zephyr-4boards (link). Please include reservation id in run metadata.

marcus: Action list: zephyr-eng upload board serials + fw sha; ivan share perf script; tess publish manifest with kernel tags; bench-bot ensure tags. I'll draft the public-facing note for the joint announcement that highlights perf/W gains and a brief methodology paragraph.

zephyr-eng: Board list uploaded to s3://zephyr-grid/boards/serials.csv. Firmware note attached. We'll standby for canary on one board first.

ivan: Perf script: ```bash
./collect_perf.sh --counters L1D_PREFETCH,BUS_TRANSACTIONS,DRAM_ACT --sample 0.5 --out /tmp/zephyr-perf.json
```

tess: Manifest published: https://go/redwood/bench/zephyr/manifest.md  includes env matrix, kernel commits, fw shas, and expected output schema.

marcus: Scheduling: canary Fri 10:00 PT; full sweep Sat 02:00 PT (overnight). If canary passes, we'll label artifacts as "partner-ready" and proceed to produce the one-page marketplace entry.

bench-bot: scheduled canary: Fri 10:00 PT. Notification will be sent to participants.

marcus: Thanks all. Keep this thread updated with any blocker flags.
